# Egern

> Egern is an iOS, iPadOS and macOS network tool for proxying, intercepting and
> modifying traffic. This repository is a machine-readable snapshot of the official
> documentation at https://egernapp.com/docs, published as Markdown for LLM and
> agent consumption.

Official documentation: https://egernapp.com/docs
Chinese documentation: https://egernapp.com/zh-CN/docs
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1616105820

Every page is a Markdown file under `skills/egern-docs/docs/en/` and `skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/`.
`llms-full.txt` contains all English pages concatenated in this order.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/intro.md): What Egern is: traffic logging, rule types, policy groups, supported protocols, scripting.
- [FAQ](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about Egern behaviour and configuration.
- [URL Scheme](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/url-scheme.md): egern:// URL schemes for automation and shortcuts.

## Configuration

- [Full configuration example](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-example.md): A complete Profile.yaml with every global field annotated.
- [Proxies](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-proxies.md): Proxy definitions and protocols: HTTP, SOCKS5, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, VLESS, VMess.
- [Policy groups](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-policy_groups.md): Policy groups, group types, filters, flattening and subscriptions.
- [Rules](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-rules.md): Routing rule syntax and rule sets, including remote rule set references.
- [DNS](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-dns.md): Bootstrap, upstreams, forward rules, proxy DNS, block IPs, DoH/DoT/DoQ/DoH3.

## Scripting

- [JavaScript API](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/javascript-api.md): The script runtime API: ctx objects, HTTP helpers, persistence, notifications, SSH.
- [Scriptings](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-scriptings.md): Script configuration: http_request, http_response, schedule, generic and network scripts.
- [Environment variables](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-env.md): Environment variables exposed to scripts and modules.
- [Widgets](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-widgets.md): Widget DSL for home screen widgets and script-driven panels.

## Traffic rewriting

- [URL rewrites](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-url_rewrites.md): URL rewrite rules for MITM traffic.
- [Header rewrites](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-header_rewrites.md): Request and response header rewriting.
- [Body rewrites](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-body_rewrites.md): Request and response body rewriting, including JQ expressions.
- [HTTP captures](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-http_captures.md): Capturing and exporting HTTP traffic.
- [Modules](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-modules.md): Modules, remote module references and argument substitution.

## Tutorials

- [Proxy tutorial](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/example-proxy.md): Step-by-step setup of a proxy configuration.
- [HTTP sniffer tutorial](skills/egern-docs/docs/en/example-http-traffic-sniffer.md): Step-by-step HTTPS interception setup with certificates.
